description: This file defines the AzureAISearchIndexManager class, which manages Azure Search indexes including creation, deletion, retrieval, and rebuilding, with support for index metadata and field configuration.

classes.name: AzureAISearchIndexManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing Azure Search indexes, including creation, deletion, existence checks, retrieval, and rebuilding, with support for index metadata and field configuration.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new Azure Search index based on the provided IndexProfile if it does not already exist.

methods.name: ExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks if an index with the given full name exists in Azure Search.

methods.name: GetAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the SearchIndex object for the specified index full name.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes the specified index if it exists.

methods.name: RebuildAsync
methods.description: Rebuilds the specified index by deleting and recreating it.
